{{Top|leg}}
'''Area D-513''' was an area of space in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. [[X10-700 "Destroyer"]] and other members of the [[Detritus Satellites]]&mdash;sentient [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture'']] droid scavengers&mdash;operated in this area.<ref name="SWG:AAA">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Alliance Agreement}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Area D-513 was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AAA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mention of the Area D-513 was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. This area was mentioned in a rare information storage device named "An Alliance Agreement" that can be [[Wikipedia:Looting (gaming)|looted]] from droid starfighters in the Dantooine system.<ref name="SWG:AAA" />
